added.title: Director, Product Marketing
added.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, Product Marketing based in United States .

The Director, Product Marketing will lead the commercial strategy for a portfolio of innovative technology services and solutions.

This role transforms complex technical offerings into market-relevant propositions that accelerate pipeline creation and revenue growth.

You will shape solution structures, packaging, positioning, pricing logic, and go-to-market strategies across new and existing offerings.

Working closely with Sales, Delivery, Product, Alliances, and Executive teams, you will create the foundations needed for scalable market execution.

Your ability to connect customer needs with business outcomes will help differentiate solutions and strengthen their commercial impact.

You will also equip sales teams with compelling enablement resources, training, and messaging that support successful customer conversations.

This is a strategic player-coach opportunity in a lean, high-accountability environment where hands-on execution and commercial impact are equally valued.

Accountabilities

Architect clear and commercially compelling solution structures across portfolios, bundles, and use cases, ensuring offerings are easy for customers and sales teams to understand and position.
Develop standardized naming, packaging, and pricing logic that creates consistency across the portfolio and strengthens the commercial presentation of technology solutions.
Own end-to-end go-to-market strategies for new and existing offerings, translating business objectives and market opportunities into actionable plans that support pipeline creation and revenue expansion.
Define target market segments, customer personas, and priority use cases to establish clear positioning and ensure offerings address meaningful customer needs.
Create differentiated value propositions and messaging frameworks that translate complex technical capabilities into clear business outcomes and compelling market narratives.
Develop sales enablement materials, including presentations, battlecards, case studies, and other commercial tools, while training sales teams to confidently communicate offerings and value propositions.
Conduct market and competitive intelligence to identify differentiation opportunities, understand evolving customer needs, and inform offering development and lifecycle decisions.
Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Delivery, Product, Alliances, and Executive stakeholders to align offerings with market priorities and maximize commercial performance.
Use commercial, pipeline, and performance data to evaluate marketing impact, identify opportunities for improvement, and continuously strengthen go-to-market effectiveness.
Balance strategic leadership with hands-on execution, taking ownership of priorities and delivering measurable commercial outcomes in a lean and fast-moving environment.
Support additional responsibilities and strategic initiatives consistent with the objectives of the role.

Requirements

10+ years of Product Marketing experience within technology-driven sectors such as IT services, SaaS, cloud, customer experience, artificial intelligence, or digital transformation.
Proven experience developing product positioning, value propositions, messaging frameworks, and go-to-market strategies for complex B2B technology offerings.
Strong ability to translate technical capabilities into clear, differentiated commercial narratives, sales materials, and market-facing propositions that resonate with business decision-makers.
Solid experience in market research and competitive intelligence, with the analytical judgment to identify market opportunities, differentiation strategies, and implications for portfolio development.
Demonstrated success partnering with Sales, Delivery, Product, Alliances, and Executive teams to enable revenue growth and effective market execution.
Strong analytical capabilities, including experience using commercial, pipeline, and performance data to measure marketing impact and optimize go-to-market strategies.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to develop executive-level content, influence senior stakeholders, and present complex ideas clearly and persuasively.
Strong strategic thinking combined with a hands-on, execution-oriented approach and the ability to operate effectively in a lean, high-accountability environment.
A graduate degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field is required.

Benefits

Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package.
Health insurance coverage.
Language courses to support professional and personal development.
Relocation program.
Professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship, and talent investment initiatives.
Internal mobility opportunities that support long-term career growth.
Exposure to impactful projects involving leading global clients and opportunities to contribute to the evolution of technology-driven industries.
Dynamic, multicultural, and inclusive working environment with open communication and regular team-building and social activities.
Opportunity to work within a performance-driven culture focused on delivering high-quality outcomes and continuous improvement.
Commitment to social sustainability through initiatives focused on IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process
to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

added.title: Senior Manager, Product Marketing and Client Expansion
added.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Manager, Product Marketing and Client Expansion based in United States .

The Senior Manager, Product Marketing and Client Expansion will lead strategic marketing initiatives across a complex B2B SaaS portfolio.

This role combines product marketing, demand generation, client communications, and expansion strategy to translate product priorities into measurable revenue growth.

You will shape differentiated positioning, lead go-to-market launches, and develop compelling messaging that strengthens market impact and customer engagement.

Working closely with Product, Sales, Client Success, and Marketing teams, you will create enablement resources that help teams communicate product value with confidence.

You will also identify opportunities within the existing client base and build campaigns that encourage upgrades, expansion, and renewals.

Success in this role will be driven by strong storytelling, data-informed decision-making, cross-functional influence, and disciplined execution.

This is a hands-on leadership opportunity in a remote-first, globally connected environment where autonomy, innovation, and meaningful impact are highly valued.

Accountabilities

Develop compelling product positioning and messaging across multiple products and customer segments, ensuring clear differentiation and a consistent value proposition throughout the market.
Partner with Product teams to plan and execute go-to-market strategies for new products, features, and enhancements, ensuring strong alignment across Marketing, Sales, and Client Experience.
Create, write, and refine external-facing product messaging across websites, third-party review platforms, sales materials, and other customer-facing channels.
Collaborate with Sales, Product, and Client Experience teams to develop effective sales enablement resources, including pitch decks, brochures, toolkits, comparison charts, and other materials that help sales teams communicate product value.
Conduct ongoing competitive analysis and translate market intelligence into sharper positioning, messaging, and sales enablement strategies that support commercial success.
Monitor positioning and messaging performance throughout the marketing funnel, using engagement and conversion data to identify opportunities and continuously improve results.
Own the client expansion demand generation strategy in partnership with key stakeholders, identifying product priorities and customer opportunities with the greatest potential for revenue growth.
Develop persuasive narratives and benefit-driven communications that clearly demonstrate the value of upgrading, expanding, or renewing existing solutions.
Write, edit, and execute targeted client communications and campaigns designed to generate interest, strengthen engagement, and increase expansion revenue.
Partner with Client Success and Demand Generation teams to activate expansion strategies through targeted campaigns and coordinated customer engagement programs.
Test expansion messaging and campaign approaches, evaluate upgrade, expansion, and renewal performance, and refine strategies based on measurable results.
Manage multiple strategic initiatives simultaneously while maintaining focus on broader marketing priorities, business objectives, and commercial outcomes.

Requirements

7+ years of experience in B2B SaaS product marketing, including significant experience in expansion, lifecycle, or demand generation marketing.
Proven success owning go-to-market strategy and execution for a complex portfolio of solutions, from internal sales enablement through external product launches.
Exceptional writing and editing skills, with a demonstrated ability to create compelling, benefit-driven messaging that connects product capabilities with customer and business value.
Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective partnerships across Product, Sales, Client Success, Demand Generation, and broader Marketing teams.
Demonstrated ability to translate complex product concepts into clear positioning, compelling narratives, and practical marketing materials for different audiences.
Strong strategic thinking and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining focus on high-level objectives and measurable outcomes.
Experience working in a fast-paced environment is preferred, particularly within a private-equity-backed SaaS organization or similarly dynamic business.
Experience within organizations that have undergone rapid growth, multiple acquisitions, or significant portfolio expansion is strongly preferred.
A data-driven approach to marketing, with the ability to evaluate campaign, engagement, conversion, expansion, and renewal metrics and use insights to improve strategy.
A hands-on, proactive working style with strong ownership, creativity, autonomy, and the ability to move initiatives from strategy through execution.

Benefits

Remote-first work environment offering flexibility and the freedom to work remotely while remaining connected through global collaboration and virtual technology.
Opportunity to work with a globally distributed team and collaborate across diverse functions, perspectives, industries, and markets.
Competitive salary and benefits package.
Tuition and lifestyle reimbursement programs to support professional development and personal well-being.
Bespoke mindfulness and fitness initiatives designed to support employee wellness.
Flexible PTO policy that gives employees greater autonomy over their time and supports sustainable work-life balance.
Professional and personal development opportunities through cross-functional collaboration, diverse projects, and exposure to a broad range of expertise.
Opportunities for internal mobility, career growth, and leadership development within a larger and expanding organization.
High level of autonomy and responsibility, encouraging creative problem-solving, independent thinking, and innovation.
Employee recognition culture that celebrates strong contributions and achievements.
Commitment to an inclusive and diverse workplace, with accommodations available throughout the recruitment and employment process.
